CHAPTER 4 — ORIGINAL-TOPIC COVERAGE AND TEACHING OUTLINE

This edition is independent of the historical tutorial directory. Historical
page names below identify material audited during the rewrite, not dependencies.

trajectories: machine learning trajectories.md: measured comparison and generalization

Main teaching sequence
1. Observe Chapter 3 with its existing speed settings.
2. Change steering only; target ahead on the centerline, then heading error.
3. Tune lookahead one constant at a time; observe anticipation and cutting.
4. Add road-edge feedback; distinguish center, footprint and swept trajectory.
5. Try higher speed and the bounded short-turn heuristic separately.
6. Explore vector/line mathematics and alternative trajectory approaches.

Implementation order: geometry and target tests -> simulator baseline comparison
-> tune default settings -> text and diagrams -> independent download checks.
Private automation, telemetry and simulator fixtures are not teaching requirements.
